reuse.why: linkFintegraAccount is a thin adapter over the existing linkBankSyncAccount helper, inheriting the duplicate-link refusal, and the sync path reuses processBankSyncDownload's startingBalance branch.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions copies the Akahu/Pluggy download function body; the tree has no shared downloader, so this follows the existing per-provider pattern but still adds a copied block.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, server path in server-config.ts and type in types/models, each beside its sibling providers.

scope.why: Only the additions needed for a new provider plus minimal client type-map entries and tests.

maintainability.why: Easy to own and consistent with sibling providers; the only debt is one more near-identical download function.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions is an undisguised copy of the provider download pattern.
